evidence.notes: Typed String query with USER_MODE returns persisted Account rows.
Typed String count query with USER_MODE returns the seeded row count.
Typed count query and binds with USER_MODE return the matching count.
Inline SOQL produces an iterable QueryLocator.
Typed String query with USER_MODE produces an iterable QueryLocator.

source.content: Account hot = new Account(Name = 'Hot Account', Rating = 'Hot'); Account warm = new Account(Name = 'Warm Account', Rating = 'Warm'); insert new List<Account>{hot, warm}; Set<Id> fixtureIds = new Set<Id>{hot.Id, warm.Id}; List<Account> allRows = Database.query('SELECT Id, Name, Rating FROM Account WHERE Id IN :fixtureIds ORDER BY Name', AccessLevel.USER_MODE); System.assertEquals(2, allRows.size()); Map<String,Object> binds = new Map<String,Object>{'fixtureIds' => fixtureIds, 'rating' => 'Warm'}; System.assertEquals(2, Database.countQuery('SELECT COUNT() FROM Account WHERE Id IN :fixtureIds', AccessLevel.USER_MODE)); System.assertEquals(1, Database.countQueryWithBinds('SELECT COUNT() FROM Account WHERE Id IN :fixtureIds AND Rating = :rating', binds, AccessLevel.USER_MODE)); Database.QueryLocator listLocator = Database.getQueryLocator([SELECT Id, Name, Rating FROM Account WHERE Id IN :fixtureIds ORDER BY Name]); Iterator<SObject> listIterator = listLocator.iterator(); System.assert(listIterator.hasNext()); Database.QueryLocator stringLocator = Database.getQueryLocator('SELECT Id, Name FROM Account WHERE Id IN :fixtureIds ORDER BY Name', AccessLevel.USER_MODE); Iterator<SObject> stringIterator = stringLocator.iterator(); System.assert(stringIterator.hasNext());
